description:
HTTP Injector Pro patch bundle v1.0.3 for HTTP Injector 6.5.0 (versionCode 244).

Fixes the v1.0.2 crash. This version keeps the known-working modded helper fully intact and changes only ONE instruction: the JNI CallVoidMethod that invokes `Toast.show()`. The toast object is still constructed but never displayed, so there is no visible modder toast and no anti-tamper logic is disturbed.

- Pro unlock: 40-byte runtime patch applied directly to the original libevozi_sentinel.so
- libDexHelper.so: premium version, needed to load the helper
- libdexfix.so: identical to the working premium helper except a single NOP at virtual 0x3660 (the show() call)
- No `Mod By :MafiaSSS` toast, no modder-owned sentinel library

Bundle SHA-256: `cdcb9e6f2d3dd23606f06c8a33b15149ed6e84a3d392349e087080e2b016b7a9`

Patch the original `.apks` bundle in Morphe. Server-side account/purchase features still depend on Evozi's servers.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks HTTP Injector's locally enforced Pro features without modder toast.
